key_changes.summary: Spec counter increased; config-bit change during master transmission now aborts the transmission and forces idle state.
CPHA=0 slave-mode transfer description changed; CPHA=1 master-mode transfer description changed; bidirectional master-mode mode-fault note added.
Enhanced receive-buffer functionality (SPIF / SPIDR handling on missed-read case); SPI-slave in wait/stop mode behavior clarified; max-allowed-baud-rate note added.
Minor rewording of Section 3.1.5 (SPI Data Register).

backward_compat_traps.v0_2_x_and_earlier: Behavior of changing CPOL/MSTR/etc. during an in-progress transmission was not specified.
backward_compat_traps.v03_00_and_later: Any change of a config bit during master-mode in-progress transmission aborts the transmission and forces idle state.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Drivers ported from pre-V03.00 may rely on changing CPOL on-the-fly during a transmission; after V03.00 this aborts the transfer.

backward_compat_traps.pre_V04_00: Third-byte handling when SPIF still set was implementation-defined.
backward_compat_traps.V04_00_and_later: If SPIF still set and a second byte already buffered, a third byte's reception causes the second byte in shift register to be lost (Figure 3-7).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Polling loops that ignore SPIF latency may silently lose bytes after V04.00.

fields.version_naming_history_note: Early dot-versions (0.1-0.8) became formal V02.02 in July 2001 (renamed for SRS2.0 template); subsequent versions follow V0Maj.Min scheme.
